title: Provably Efficient Concave Utility Reinforcement Learning with Linear Function Approximation
abstract: arXiv:2611.34678v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Concave utility reinforcement learning (CURL) unifies a diverse range of problems, including standard reinforcement learning (RL), imitation learning, and maximum entropy exploration. Unlike standard RL, CURL generally requires estimating high-dimensional state-action occupancy measures. Consequently, existing methods for CURL either sidestep the exploration problem, are restricted to the tabular setting, or lack computationally efficient policy optimization. To address this, we study CURL in finite-horizon episodic bilinear MDPs, where the transition model admits a low-dimensional representation in known feature spaces. We use the bilinear structure to efficiently estimate occupancy measures via low-dimensional feature expectations, and propose a model-based optimistic concave utility policy optimization (OCUPO) framework. translated_title: 可证明高效的线性函数逼近凹效用强化学习
translated_abstract: 凹效用强化学习（CURL）统一了多种问题类型，包括标准强化学习（RL）、模仿学习和最大熵探索。与标准RL不同，CURL通常需要估计高维的状态-动作占用度量。因此，现有的CURL方法要么回避了探索问题，要么仅限于表格型设置，要么缺乏计算高效的策略优化。为解决这些问题，我们在有限水平回合制双线性MDP中研究CURL，其中转移模型在已知特征空间中具有低维表示。我们利用双线性结构通过低维特征期望高效估计占用度量，并提出了基于模型的乐观凹效用策略优化（OCUPO）框架。我们首先在在策略（on-policy）设置下实例化OCUPO，其中每次迭代使用独立轨迹进行估计
tldr: 本文提出基于模型的乐观凹效用策略优化（OCUPO）框架，利用双线性MDP的低维结构高效估计状态-动作占用度量，首次在线性函数逼近下实现了可证明高效的凹效用强化学习。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a model-based optimistic concave utility policy optimization (OCUPO) framework that leverages the low-dimensional bilinear MDP structure to efficiently estimate occupancy measures, achieving the first provably efficient concave utility reinforcement learning with linear function approximation.
